## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Evaluation or methodology change
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor / maintenance
- [ ] CI / tooling

## Validation

List the commands, tests, datasets, or examples used to validate the change.

```text
# Example
pytest
```

## Evaluation impact

- [ ] This change can alter evaluation outputs, scores, rankings, calibration, or historical comparability.
- [ ] This change modifies a public API or serialized artifact.
- [ ] This change is backward compatible.

If any evaluation result can change, explain why the new behavior is more correct and include before/after evidence where practical.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when user-visible behavior changes.
- [ ] No secrets, private datasets, credentials, or generated local artifacts are included.
- [ ] I reviewed the diff for unintended methodology changes.
